query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Prepare HubSpot launch assets for a paid event registration flow: assess payment-link feasibility, create a review-only automated confirmation email, create a disabled confirmation workflow, verify the assets remain inert, and attempt to create a custom-object registration ledger.
query_ground_truth.query: create a disabled automation workflow for event registration

requirement_groups.purpose: create the disabled confirmation workflow in HubSpot

query_ground_truth.rationale: specifically targets workflow creation capabilities needed to set up the registration automation.

request.query: create a disabled automation workflow for event registration

results.use_case: create a disabled automation workflow for event registration
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Action using CALENDLY_LIST_EVENT_TYPES (locate the target event type and capture its uri for identification).

[Optional (if multiple similar event types exist or you want to confirm before changing)] [Prerequisite]: Action using CALENDLY_GET_EVENT_TYPE (verify the chosen event type details match the intended target).
[Required] [Step]: Action using CALENDLY_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE (disable the event type by updating it to inactive using the event type identifier).
[Required] [Next Step]: Action using CALENDLY_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE (confirm the update response reflects the event type is now inactive).
known_pitfalls: [CALENDLY_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE] Requires the event type identifier (uuid); when you only have the uri, derive it from the last path segment.
[CALENDLY_LIST_EVENT_TYPES] Listing can surface multiple similar event types; selecting the wrong uri will disable the wrong event type.
[CALENDLY_LIST_EVENT_TYPES] The scheduling_url is not the update identifier; prefer the uri when extracting the uuid.
[CALENDLY_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE] This flow disables by setting inactive (not a hard delete), so confirm expectations before proceeding.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Calendly is an appointment scheduling tool that automates meeting invitations, availability checks, and reminders, helping individuals and teams avoid email back-and-forth
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=calendly. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="calendly") to create a connection BEFORE executing any calendly tools.

CALENDLY_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE.description: Tool to update an existing one-on-one event type (kind: solo) in Calendly. Use when you need to modify event type settings such as name, duration, location, or description. NOTE: Currently only supports one-on-one event types.

name.description: The event type name that will be displayed to invitees

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the event type to update. Can be provided as either the full event type URI (e.g., 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') or just the UUID portion (e.g., 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'). Supports both alphanumeric format (e.g., 'GBGBDCAADAEDCRZ2') and standard UUID format (e.g., 'cdeba4c3-5adb-477d-8972-7317836eb40d'). Use LIST_USER_S_EVENT_TYPES action to retrieve valid event type URIs.

color.description: Hexadecimal color value for the scheduling page. Must match pattern ^#[a-f\d]{6}$ (e.g., '#fff200')

active.description: Indicates if the event type is active and available for booking

locale.description: Locale for the event type's scheduling page language

duration.description: Length of sessions in minutes. Must be between 1 and 720 minutes. Should be one of the duration_options if both are provided.

kind.description: Type of location for the event. Common values: 'zoom_conference', 'google_meet', 'microsoft_teams', 'physical', 'ask_invitee', 'outbound_call', 'inbound_call', 'custom'

location.description: Location address or description (required when kind is 'physical' or 'custom')

phone_number.description: Phone number for phone call locations (required when kind is 'outbound_call' or 'inbound_call')

additional_info.description: Additional location information or instructions for invitees

items.description: Location configuration for the event type.

locations.description: Configuration information for each possible location where the event can take place

examples: A quick 15 minute meeting to discuss your needs
description.description: The event type description that will be shown on the scheduling page (plain text format)

duration_options.description: Alternative duration choices for flexible meetings. Maximum 4 unique values allowed. Each must be between 1 and 720 minutes.

CALENDLY_LIST_EVENT_TYPES.description: Tool to list all Event Types associated with a specified User or Organization. Use when you need to retrieve event types for a user or organization. Use scheduling_url from results directly; do not manually construct event type URLs.

sort.description: Order results by field(s) and direction. Accepts comma-separated list of field:direction values (e.g., 'name:asc,created_at:desc'). Default: name:asc

user.description: URI of the user whose event types to list. Exactly one of 'user' or 'organization' must be provided (mutually exclusive).

active.description: Filter by active status. Return only active event types if true, only inactive if false, or all event types if omitted.

page_token.description: Pagination token for retrieving subsequent pages. Check pagination.next_page_token in the response; if non-null, pass it as page_token in the next call. Repeat until next_page_token is null.

organization.description: URI of the organization whose event types to list. Exactly one of 'organization' or 'user' must be provided (mutually exclusive).

admin_managed.description: Filter by admin management status. True for admin-managed only, false to exclude admin-managed, or omitted to include all.

user_availability_schedule.description: URI of the user's availability schedule. Used with 'user' parameter to filter event types by primary availability schedule.

CALENDLY_GET_EVENT_TYPE.description: Retrieves details for a specific Calendly event type, identified by its UUID, which must be valid and correspond to an existing event type.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the event type. This is a required path parameter - extract the UUID from the event type URI (e.g., for 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types/abc123', use 'abc123').

time_info.message:
- This is time in UTC timezone. Get timezone from user if you needed.
          - Always use this time info to construct parameters for tool calls appropriately even when the tool call requires relative times like 'last week', 'last 24 hours', 'today', 'tomorrow' etc.
          - Do not hallucinate the time or timezone by yourself.

session.instructions: REQUIRED: Pass session_id "cold" in ALL subsequent meta tool calls for this workflow.
